---
title: "Wetland Water Quality Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
---
<style>
.legend-bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 10px 0;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  background: #f8f8f8;
  border-top: 1px solid #ccc;
}

.legend-item {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.legend-img {
  width: 140px;
  height: 12px;
  display: block;
  margin: 4px auto;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
}
</style>



```{r}
library(flexdashboard)
library(htmltools)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)
library(janitor)
library(plotly)
library(cder)
library(dataRetrieval)

# ---- POINT DATA FOR MAP ----

smst <- read.csv(
  "../data/2026-01-26_Managed_Wetland_Scouting_Trip_a.csv",
  skip = 1,
  fileEncoding = "latin1",
  encoding = "UTF-8",
  check.names = FALSE
)

names(smst) <- iconv(names(smst), from = "latin1", to = "UTF-8")
names(smst) <- janitor::make_clean_names(names(smst))

df <- smst

vars <- c(
  "chlorophyll_ug_l", 
  "f_dom_qsu", 
  "odo_mg_l", 
  "sp_cond_am_s_cm",
  "tal_pc_ug_l", 
  "turbidity_fnu", 
  "p_h", 
  "temp_a_c"
)

legend_positions <- c(
  "chlorophyll_ug_l" = "bottomright",
  "f_dom_qsu"        = "bottomleft",
  "odo_mg_l"         = "topright",
  "sp_cond_am_s_cm"  = "topleft",
  "tal_pc_ug_l"      = "bottomright",
  "turbidity_fnu"    = "bottomleft",
  "p_h"              = "topright",
  "temp_a_c"         = "topleft"
)


# palettes for each parameter
pal_list <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  colorNumeric("viridis", df[[v]], na.color = "gray50")
})
names(pal_list) <- vars

# ---- CONTINUOUS WATER QUALITY DATA ----

# CDEC
Meins <- cdec_query(
  "MEI",
  sensors = c(
    266, # FDOM
    25,  # water temperature in F
    62,  # pH
    221, # turbidity FNU
    28,  # Chlorophyll
    61,  # dissolved oxygen mg/L
    275, # phycocyanin fluorescence
    100  # EC uS/cm
  ),
  start.date = ymd("2026-04-01"),
  end.date = today()
) |>
  mutate(
    Value = case_when(
      SensorType == "TEMP W" ~ (Value - 32) * 5/9,
      TRUE ~ Value
    )
  )

# USGS
USGSstations <- read_waterdata_continuous(
  monitoring_location_id = c(
    "USGS-11455730",
    "USGS-381126121554801",
    "USGS-381154121545401"
  ),
  time = c("2026-01-01", "2026-05-21")
)

USGS <- USGSstations |>
  rename(
    StationID    = monitoring_location_id,
    SensorNumber = parameter_code,
    DateTime     = time,
    Value        = value,
    SensorUnits  = unit_of_measure
  ) |>
  mutate(
    SensorType = case_when(
      SensorUnits == "%"       ~ "DO Percent",
      SensorUnits == "pH Units"~ "PH VAL",
      SensorUnits == "mg/l"    ~ "DIS OXY",
      SensorUnits == "uS/cm"   ~ "EL COND",
      SensorUnits == "ug/l"    ~ "CHLORPH",
      SensorUnits == "degC"    ~ "TEMP W",
      SensorUnits == "QSE"     ~ "FDOM",
      SensorUnits == "RFU"     ~ "FLURFUB",
      SensorUnits == "_FNU"    ~ "TURB WF",
      TRUE                     ~ SensorUnits
    ),
    Station = case_match(
      StationID,
      "USGS-11455730" ~ "Lower Joice Island",
      "USGS-381126121554801" ~ "Nurse Slough",
      "USGS-381154121545401" ~ "Denverton",
      .default = StationID
    )

  )

allWQ <- bind_rows(
  USGS,
  Meins |>
    mutate(
      Station      = "Meins Interior",
      SensorNumber = as.character(SensorNumber)
    )
)
```
Page 1: Map
=====================================

```{r}
m <- leaflet(df) |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery", group = "Satellite") |>
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap", group = "OSM")

for (v in vars) {
  pal <- pal_list[[v]]

  m <- m |>
    addCircleMarkers(
      data = df,
      lng = ~gps_longitude_a,
      lat = ~gps_latitude_a,
      radius = 6,
      color = ~pal(df[[v]]),
      fillOpacity = 0.8,
      popup = ~paste0(
        "<b>", v, ":</b> ", df[[v]], "<br>",
        "<b>Date:</b> ", date_mm_dd_yyyy, "<br>",
        "<b>Time:</b> ", time_hh_mm_ss
      ),
      group = v
    )
}

m |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups    = c("Satellite", "OSM"),
    overlayGroups = vars,
    options       = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
legend_files <- list()

for (v in vars) {
  pal <- pal_list[[v]]
  png_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

  # Create a 1x100 color bar
  z <- matrix(seq(0, 1, length.out = 100), nrow = 1)

  png(png_file, width = 400, height = 30)
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))  # no margins
  plot(0, 0, type = "n", axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "",
       xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))
  rasterImage(
    pal(seq(min(df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
            max(df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
            length.out = 100)),
    0, 0, 1, 1
  )
  dev.off()

  legend_files[[v]] <- png_file
}


div(class = "legend-bar",
    lapply(vars, function(v) {
      div(class = "legend-item",
          tags$div(v),
          tags$img(src = legend_files[[v]], class = "legend-img")
      )
    })
)

```

Page 2: Continuous Water Quality
=====================================

```{r}
p <- ggplot(allWQ, aes(x = DateTime, y = Value, color = Station)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~SensorType, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Value", color = "Station")

ggplotly(p)
```
